# `prepaid_bucket`

Area: **billing** ([all tables](README.md))

Stable TMF654 bucket and accumulatedBalance identities for one prepaid account/currency. No stored balance; funding ledger is introduced separately.

## Columns

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` | no | `gen_random_uuid()` | Stable TMF654 bucket identity. |
| `accumulated_balance_id` | `uuid` | no | `gen_random_uuid()` | Stable TMF654 accumulatedBalance identity; one bucket per account/currency. |
| `billing_account_id` | `uuid` | no |  | Owning prepaid billing account. |
| `currency` | `text` | no |  | Account currency, enforced by a composite foreign key. |
| `rating_type` | `text` | no | `'prepaid'::text` | Constant prepaid, enforcing the owning account mode. |
| `created_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no |  | Creation instant from the injected clock. |
